segments.title: Teleprompter Debut & Crumbs Miss Scheduling
segments.notes: Case unveils new Elgato teleprompter, negotiates Crumbs Miss holiday stream for Sunday 5pm PST/8pm EST with chat input, discusses Munch & Crum employment status.

segments.title: Twitch Sexual Content Policy Overhaul
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple cover Twitch's updated guidelines allowing fictionalized nudity, labeled sexual content, and twerking/pole dancing without labels; Case and Jeff test 'topless meta' on camera.

segments.title: Steve Hog Hog Expert Consultation
segments.notes: Case summons 'hog expert' Steve Hog Hog to weigh in on Twitch nudity rules; Steve claims 236 teats, reveals Christmas ham suicide pact, and is dismissed as a 'capitalistic death cult' member.

segments.title: Lethal Company Transition & Crum Cliffhanger
segments.notes: Case wraps to join Kendelle, John Madden, and others for Lethal Company; Crum's attendance uncertain after quit threats, Trip on the Street deferred to tomorrow.

characters.name: Case Blackwell

characters.name: Pepito

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-anchored Twitch policy coverage, bared chest for 'topless meta', debated hog expertise jurisdiction with Case.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Absent but heavily discussed; threatened to quit, Crumbs Miss appearance uncertain, gambling addiction referenced.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Referenced as Crum's debate rival; Case claims ownership over Crum's schedule.

characters.name: Steve Hog Hog
characters.notes: call-in guest. Self-proclaimed hog expert with 236 teats; advocated hog display freedom, planned Christmas ham self-sacrifice.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Mentioned as potential Lethal Company player; yawned at Case when asked.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Referenced in wall/crawlspace context during unionization joke.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell debuts a teleprompter and negotiates a Sunday Crumbs Miss holiday stream while covering Twitch's revised sexual content policy with Jeff Ripple, including a live 'topless meta' demonstration. The broadcast veers into absurdity with the introduction of 'hog expert' Steve Hog Hog, who claims 236 teats and a Christmas ham martyrdom fetish. The episode ends with Case departing for Lethal Company alongside Kendelle and John Madden, leaving Crum's employment status unresolved after quit threats.
